report.title: 📋  Metadata Summary
report.strip_desc: GPS, camera model, timestamps and all other EXIF data will be permanently removed.
report.keep_desc: The original metadata is kept, except the hidden preview of the unedited photo.
report.strip_list_title: The following data will be permanently removed:

troll.name: 🌊 Troll Profile
troll.desc: Random vintage camera · Random ocean GPS · Recent-ish date

artist.name: 🎨 Artist Profile
artist.desc: Hides GPS & camera device · Keeps copyright field

blend.name: 🫥 Blend in
blend.desc: A current phone · a spot a few km away · the date shifted by days

report.location_desc: The GPS coordinates are removed; the rest of the metadata is kept.
report.custom_desc: Each field is kept, removed or replaced as you set it in the metadata editor.
report.unsupported_title: 🗑  This file type can't hold metadata
report.unsupported_desc: BMP and similar formats have no place for metadata, so the saved file has none.
report.no_metadata: This photo has no metadata to keep or remove.
report.thumbnail_note: Phones and cameras hide a small preview of the original photo inside the file. It shows the photo before your edits, faces included, so DotScramble always removes it.
report.xmp_note: XMP can hold your edit history and where people's faces are, sometimes with their names. It is always removed.
report.extra_images_note: Some phones hide more images after the photo (depth maps, previews). They are always removed.
report.text_note: Text notes can hold comments or, in AI-made images, the prompt. They are always removed.

verify.thumbnail: it still contained a preview of the original photo
verify.gps_left: it still contained the GPS location
verify.real_gps: it contained the real location instead of the decoy
verify.extras_left: it still contained XMP, IPTC, text notes or extra images

cleaner.title: 🧹  Clean metadata only
cleaner.intro: Removes metadata from photos without changing a single pixel. Each result is saved next to the original as name_clean; the original isn't touched.
